column1: # OWASP ZAP rule configuration for outlook-mcp-hardened.
# Most rules at WARN by default. The ones below are tuned for our context :
# unauthenticated baseline scan against the discovery endpoint + boot probe.
# /mcp itself requires Bearer auth so ZAP cannot scan its body without
# credentials — that's by design (N0 I2 fix).

column3: Content Security Policy header — discovery JSON has no CSP needed
Permissions-Policy missing — not relevant for OAuth discovery JSON
Information Disclosure - Suspicious Comments — JSDoc comments are intentional
Timestamp Disclosure — discovery has no timestamps anyway
